long_description:
BAY AREA! We've got a lot to be thankful for this year, but the people we get to dance with are right at the top of the list 🥂

This Thanksgiving weekend, we're trading the dinner table for the dance floor and bringing the whole community together for a proper Friendsgiving celebration.

A little Bollywood nostalgia, a lot of questionable singing, your favourite people in one room, and RAYTRIX & RAAG taking care of the soundtrack ✨

Whether you grew up here or found your people along the way, this one's for the friendships that make the Bay feel like home.

🗓 Friday, November 27

📍 Opal Lounge, 251 Castro St, Mountain View

🎧 RAYTRIX & RAAG 

Also check out other Business events in Mountain View.
